name: Browser Automation
description: All-in-one browser automation + scraping toolkit — navigation, forms, smart waits, infinite-scroll, paywall-bypass article extraction, PDF, network/API capture, downloads, proxy, and a VNC human-in-the-loop CAPTCHA handoff.
author: Crow
notes: 27 MCP tools. Headful Chrome in Docker (Xvfb + VNC). Paywall fallback ladder (archive.today/Wayback/12ft), hidden-API/response capture, file downloads, per-launch proxy, richer stealth (WebRTC/canvas/audio). Ships two skills: the toolkit guide + a reusable scrape-recipe template. CDP and VNC bind to localhost only.
